scripts.dev:api: cd services/api && if [ ! -x .venv/bin/python ]; then python3 -m venv .venv; fi && if ! .venv/bin/python -c "import fastapi, uvicorn" >/dev/null 2>&1; then .venv/bin/python -m pip install -e ".[dev]" >/dev/null; fi && .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload
scripts.test:api: cd services/api && if [ ! -x .venv/bin/python ]; then python3 -m venv .venv; fi && if ! .venv/bin/python -c "import fastapi, openpyxl, pytest" >/dev/null 2>&1; then .venv/bin/python -m pip install -e ".[dev]" >/dev/null; fi && .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests -q
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:word-addin && npm run check:api
scripts.test: npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:word-addin && npm run test:api && npm run check:api
